_README: Central Digimon-name alias map. Each canonical name (the spelling we want to match ON) maps to a list of alternate spellings the servers use for the SAME digimon — typically English-dub vs Japanese-romanized names. Used by builders/aliases.py to fold every spelling onto one key so cross-server data lines up. ONLY add a pair after confirming on wikimon.net that it is genuinely one digimon under two names; do NOT list two distinct digimon (e.g. MachGaogamon != MirageGaogamon, both real and one stage apart).
